decisions.reason: The existing Stripe prerequisites remain valid: usage is measured before Stripe integration and measured usage informs the tiers. Aggregating those measurements by prompt type does not necessarily change the payment Requirement.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording Supabase storage, per-call dimensions and metrics, and average usage aggregation by prompt type; no additional change or removal is required.
The subscription-tier measurement basis does not change the mood-board generation capability, provider, or interaction mode.
The usage aggregation decision does not change the selfie-styling evaluation method, provider, or required result delivery.
The source uses Veyra AI as the subject of usage tracking but does not change the existing Veyra provider constraint or OpenAI exclusion.
